kapak.alt: An early example of prescriptive formulas

youtube.baslik: How was hearing aid gain first calculated? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The best-known early example of prescription is the half-gain rule proposed by Lybarger in 1944: the aid should give gain equal to about half the threshold loss at each frequency. Today the most common generic formulas in the clinic are NAL-NL2 and DSL v5.
